description: This Java class defines the CustomerAttribute entity, representing customer-specific attributes in the sales management system. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, including relationships to Customer, CustomerOption, and CustomerOptionValue entities, with fields such as id and textValue.

classes.name: CustomerAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer attribute, with relationships to options, values, and associated customer.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the CustomerAttribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the CustomerAttribute.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the Customer linked to this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer with this attribute.

methods.name: getTextValue
methods.description: Returns the text value stored in the attribute.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.description: Sets the text value for this customer attribute.
